messages:
maria_ae: Quick sync for AtlasBank POC. They want a compact performance validation: two 3-hour steady phases at 200 qps (context-heavy + decode-heavy), one 45s spike to 1k qps, streaming=true, KV cache mem-only. Deliverables: latency (p95/p99), GPU util, and a cost-per-1M-tokens comparison Hosted vs Reserved. Can we confirm run plan and security constraints? (cc @sam_soleng @jordan_ml @alyssa_security @ravi_product)

sam_soleng: We can run from sales-dedicated-1. Proposed window: warmup 15m, ramp 20m -> 200 qps, steady A 3h, spike 45s to 1k, recovery 10m, steady B 3h, cooldown 15m. Need replays and whether to include cold-start queries.

maria_ae: AtlasBank wants some cold-starts included (10% of traffic) to capture compile times. They also requested token-level cost and a 3/6/12 month break-even table.

jordan_ml: I'll produce two replay sets and a small cold-start sample. Uploads to s3://redwood-poc/atlasbank/1788000001/. I'll include a README with seeds and randomization. Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, tokens/request, GPU mem/SM util, and model compile time.

sam_soleng: Draft run command:
```
./bench --url=https://dedicated.sales.redwood/v1/generate \ 
  --model=open-llama-7b --qps=200 --dur=21600 --streaming=true \ 
  --replay=s3://redwood-poc/atlasbank/1788000001/context-heavy.json \ 
  --kv-cache=memonly --prom=http://prom:9090 --coldpct=10
```
Will pin node pool and disable any persistent cache.

alyssa_security: Security notes: KV cache mem-only and cleared between runs, logs redacted (no raw prompts), KMS: recommend customer-managed for production; for demo we can use Redwood-managed but document differences. I'll prepare a short security memo and answer the questionnaire items about data residency and retention (<30 days).

ravi_product: For pricing: I need measured tokens/sec and effective GPU throughput under our batching config. I'll prepare a cost model comparing: (A) Reserved commit (assume 8xA10G amortized) + ops, (B) Hosted PAYG with burst credits. Will show per-1M-token and break-even months.

maria_ae: AtlasBank requested the run next Thu 2026-02-12 09:00-17:00 PT and a 30m exec readout same day. Can we reserve infra?

sam_soleng: Booked tentatively. @deploy-bot reserve 5 A10G in sales-dedicated-1 for 2026-02-12T09:00:00-17:00:00 PT. I'll post final commands 2 hours before the run.

deploy-bot: Reservation requested: pool=sales-dedicated-1, nodes=5, window=2026-02-12T09:00:00-17:00:00-08:00. Status: pending ops approval.

ops-bot: Note: will disable host swap, mount ephemeral NVMe, and restrict egress to results bucket. No logs will persist beyond configured retention.

maria_ae: Action items recap: sam finalize infra + final command; jordan upload replays + dashboards; alyssa security memo + questionnaire answers; ravi pricing model + report. I'll confirm with AtlasBank once reservation is approved.

sam_soleng: No infra blockers. I'll share PromQL and Grafana panels before the run.

jordan_ml: Replays will be uploaded by EOD Mon to s3://redwood-poc/atlasbank/1788000001/. README included.

maria_ae: Thanks team 680 4c44b0. Please update this thread with artifacts.
